summary: P2 (probe): the caller note's downgrade path 'run `canon migrate --revert` with 0.42 first (closed changes are then required again)' fails in both cases it is written for. A repo whose line came from 0.42 `canon init` has no backup: MIGRATION_INVALID 'no backup ... canon migrate --commit has not run here'. A migrated repo that closed a change refuses: MIGRATION_CONFLICT 'a file changed after canon migrate ran, and a revert would discard that change: .canon/ledger/kind=change_state/...'. Only an immediate revert (change_drop_26) works. Fix the note (and the brief's F8 caller note): delete the `change_state:` line under `routing:` by hand before running 0.41; `--revert` only right after the migrate.
